name: Grasping Root
description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature not grappled by the creature. Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until the grapple ends, the target takes 9 (1d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. The root has AC 15 and can be severed by dealing 6 or more slashing damage to it on one attack. Cutting the root doesn’t hurt the creature but ends the grapple.
